description: This file defines a PHP class LoggerAppenderConsole, which is a part of the log4php logging framework. It implements a console appender that outputs log messages to standard output (stdout) or standard error (stderr) based on user configuration. The class includes methods for setting the target, activating options, appending log events, and closing the output stream.

classes.name: LoggerAppenderConsole
classes.description: A console appender that directs log output to stdout or stderr based on configuration.

methods.name: LoggerAppenderConsole
methods.description: Constructor method for LoggerAppenderConsole, initializing with a name.

methods.name: setTarget
methods.description: Sets the target output device, either stdout or stderr, with validation.

methods.name: getTarget
methods.description: Returns the current target output address.

methods.name: activateOptions
methods.description: Activates configuration options, including opening the output stream and writing header if available.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the output stream, writes footer if available, and releases resources.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Formats the log event and writes it to the output stream.
